mapper.insert: INSERT INTO survey_task (survey_id, start_date, end_date, emails, status, error_msg, send_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{surveyId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{emails}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{sendTime}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: SELECT id, survey_id AS surveyId, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, emails, status, error_msg AS errorMsg, send_time AS sendTime FROM survey_task WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE survey_task SET status = 1, send_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE survey_task SET status = 2, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
